# NIT7ER Academy

> The high-performance modern institute of applied creative technology, systems engineering, Flow7 cognitive performance, and technical writing.

NIT7ER Academy is the educational and apprenticeship division of NIT7ER Studio (an active commercial creative technology and systems architecture agency). The Academy prepares self-driven engineers, designers, and systems thinkers through direct studio sprints, commercial codebase immersion, and rigorous capstone defense.

## Canonical Identity & Entity Links
- Institution: NIT7ER Academy
- Canonical Website: https://nit7er-academy.vercel.app
- Parent Organization: NIT7ER Studio (Commercial Agency: https://nit7er.vercel.app)
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria
- Founder & Creative Director: Abdullah Qaasim-Falade (https://github.com/Alqaasimee-jr2, https://linkedin.com/in/abdullahqaasimf001)
- Core Team: Abdullah Qaasim-Falade (Creative Director & Founder), Yaasir Olajumoke (Visual Design Lead), The G3neral (User Experience Lead)
- Core Methodology: Studio Sprints, Flow7 Reality Protocol, Verified Capstone Architecture Defense, Direct Agency Apprenticeship Pipeline

## Foundational Disciplines & Faculties
1. Faculty 01: Creative Technology & Software Engineering (`/programs/creative-tech`)
   - Focus: Web infrastructure, mobile engineering, applied AI integration, and production systems.
   - Tracks:
     - SWE-101: Full-Stack Web Engineering (`/programs/creative-tech/full-stack-web`)
     - SWE-102: Mobile App Engineering (`/programs/creative-tech/mobile-app-engineering`)
     - SWE-103: Applied AI & Intelligent Systems (`/programs/creative-tech/applied-ai-systems`)
2. Faculty 02: Systems Architecture & Cognitive Performance (`/programs/cognitive-performance`)
   - Focus: Focus stamina, cognitive mechanics, mental clarity, and systematic problem solving.
   - Tracks:
     - COG-201: Deep Work & Attention Engineering (Flow7) (`/programs/cognitive-performance/deep-work-attention`)
     - COG-202: Personal Operating Systems & Execution (`/programs/cognitive-performance/personal-operating-systems`)
3. Faculty 03: Professional Writing & Thought Leadership (`/programs/writing-thought-leadership`)
   - Focus: Systems documentation, engineering manifestos, intellectual clarity, and brand prose.
   - Tracks:
     - WRT-301: Technical Writing & Documentation (`/programs/writing-thought-leadership/technical-writing-architecture`)
     - WRT-302: Essay Craft & Thought Leadership (`/programs/writing-thought-leadership/essay-craft-thought-leadership`)
     - WRT-303: Copywriting & Clear Communication (`/programs/writing-thought-leadership/high-conversion-copywriting`)
4. Faculty 04: Computer Foundations & Applied Literacy (`/programs/computer-education`)
   - Focus: Computing first-principles, OS fundamentals, cloud collaboration, cyber hygiene, and automation.
   - Tracks:
     - CMP-401: Computer Fundamentals & OS Mastery (`/programs/computer-education/computer-fundamentals-os`)
     - CMP-402: Productivity Suites & Cloud Collaboration (`/programs/computer-education/productivity-suites-cloud`)
     - CMP-403: Internet Literacy, AI Tools & Cyber Hygiene (`/programs/computer-education/internet-literacy-cyber-hygiene`)
     - CMP-404: Computational Thinking & Everyday Automation (`/programs/computer-education/computational-thinking-automation`)

## Pedagogical Architecture: The 4-Phase System
1. Phase 01: Systems Foundations & Diagnostic (Core mental models and environmental setup)
2. Phase 02: Architectural Blueprint & Prototyping (Specifications, diagrams, and low-level prototypes)
3. Phase 03: Studio Sprints & Reality Logging (Weekly sprint deliverables, code reviews, Flow7 time audits)
4. Phase 04: Capstone Defense & Deployment (Public architecture defense, production deployment, studio alumni induction)
